about: Snipe Shot is not drawn by Storm Drain or Follow Me (ae630f98c: before, both drew it). The Twins' double battle in the Azalea Gym against a scratch copy of Paolo's Bugsy save with a level-30 Pawmot and a level-30 Baxcalibur on the twins' platform; the Pawmot is given Snipe Shot and Water Gun, and everyone else only Splash, in the running battle (teach:). gym.py's player aims the Pawmot's move at the Ledyba. With Storm Drain on the Spinarak (set:), Snipe Shot hits the Ledyba, 25 damage; with the Spinarak using Follow Me, it hits the Ledyba again. Water Gun, the same way, is drawn to the Spinarak by Follow Me, then taken by its Storm Drain; the second time the Ledyba it was aimed at has Pressure, and the Water Gun loses one PP, not two, since it is drawn away before its PP is spent (13d7833dd).
